name: Ruiz's drawer
setup: The evidence room key is missing from the duty board. The archive holds a personal records cabinet of forty unlocked drawers with brass letter plates, one per serving officer by surname, in a room with two Husks and one twitching corpse that can rise as a Reborn.
solution: The duty log shows Officer Ruiz signed the evidence room key out at 01:12 and never returned it, and body camera clip B shows her dropping it into her own drawer. Drawers are filed by surname letter, so open drawer R.
failure: No hard failure. Every wrong drawer makes noise: two wrong pulls raise the Husks' hearing check, the third brings them to the cabinet, the fourth rises the Reborn. The key never moves.
hint_1: Nobody hid that key, Leon. Somebody filed it. Think like the woman who filed it.
hint_2: The duty log has her name on the evidence key at one twelve, and the cabinet card says one drawer per officer, by surname.
hint_3: Ruiz. R. Pull the R drawer and stop being thorough about it.
hint_trigger: Hint 1 at 60 s in the archive with no drawer opened; hint 2 at 2 wrong drawers or 2 min; hint 3 at 4 wrong drawers or 3 min 30 s.

name: The court seal on locker 17
setup: Locker 17 in the evidence room is under a court seal whose electronic bolt releases only from the PrintLock pad on Det. Sgt. Ferris's desk in CID. The player carries one sleeve of three booking print cards and must choose which to lay on the glass.
solution: The pad's standby screen registers right index, WHORL, ridge count 14, accepted 14 Sep. Only card 2, FERRIS M., is a whorl with ridge count 14, and Ferris was booked on 14 Sep on a complaint withdrawn the same day. Lay Ferris's card on the glass and the bolt on locker 17 drops; open the locker by hand downstairs.
failure: A wrong card is rejected. Three wrong reads lock the pad for 90 s and sound the desk alarm, spawning two Husks into the CID corridor. The lockout expires on its own, so the puzzle cannot dead-end.
hint_1: A sealed locker that only opens from a desk upstairs. Somebody wanted exactly one person able to open it.
hint_2: The pad is telling you what it will accept. Right index, whorl, fourteen ridges. You're carrying three cards, read the tops of them.
hint_3: The detective's own card. Ferris. Hale had him printed to scare him and left the one print that opens his own locker sitting in evidence.
hint_trigger: Hint 1 at 45 s at the pad; hint 2 at 1 wrong read or 1 min 30 s; hint 3 at 2 wrong reads or 3 min.

name: What cleared, oldest first
setup: A four-digit dial safe behind an oak panel in the chief's office holds the revolver and the brass interceptor key, which is the only route out of the station. The code is written nowhere; it is a reading rule applied to the payments ledger the player is carrying.
solution: Hale's diary gives the rule: the money that stayed, the lead figure off each, oldest first, four digits. The ledger's CLEARED rows in date order are 02 Apr 7,500, 19 May 2,000, 23 Aug 4,000 and 14 Sep 1,500, so the code is 7241. The two RETURNED rows, 8,000 and 9,250, are decoys that would give six digits and will not fit the dial.
failure: No lockout and no damage; a wrong code clicks and resets the dial. The ledger is re-readable from the pause menu, so the puzzle can be stalled but never failed. Opening the safe always fires Hale's confession, so the story cannot be skipped past.
hint_1: He wrote a whole page about not writing it down. That page is the instructions.
hint_2: Not the dates, not the reference numbers. The money that stayed. Four of the six cleared, and he wants the first figure off each, oldest first.
hint_3: Seven thousand five, two thousand, four thousand, one thousand five. Seven, two, four, one. Try it.
hint_trigger: Hint 1 at 60 s at the dial or 2 wrong entries; hint 2 at 2 min or 4 wrong entries; hint 3 at 4 min or 7 wrong entries.

name: The live floor
setup: The flooded long store has a leaking floor conduit cast into the slab. Breaker panels A and B sit on the dry walkway with a red interlock lamp between them. Energising the ring electrifies the water, which is the only reliable way to open Chief Hale's guarded chest cavity.
solution: Throw panel A then panel B within 4 seconds, with Hale standing in the water and Leon on the walkway or the stair. The ring fires for 3 s, his limbs lock back in an arch and the chest cavity stays open about 5 s. Three cycles of cavity fire kill him.
failure: More than 4 s between panels trips the interlock: both levers spring up and need 12 s to reset. Standing in the water when the ring fires does heavy damage to Leon and stuns him. Firing the ring while Hale is on the far concrete plinth wastes the cycle.
hint_1: Leon, those panels on the walkway. Read the fault card again.
hint_2: Both of them, together, or the interlock throws it back. And not while you're in the water.
hint_3: Get him out into the middle, get yourself on the walkway, then A and B straight after each other. His chest opens when the limbs pull in.
hint_trigger: Hint 1 at 45 s of the fight with no panel thrown; hint 2 at 90 s or one tripped interlock; hint 3 at 3 min or two tripped interlocks.
